Kitchen, meals & drinks · Conversation, family & daily routines

birthday cake noun

modern

Traupman 70

lībum nātāle

Examples

  • Avia lībum nātāle tibi coquit.

    Grandma is baking you a birthday cake.composed

  • ūna celebrāta est per duo lība diēs

    one day was celebrated with two birthday cakes (Ovid’s birthday, shared with his brother)Ov. Tr. 4.10.12

Other words

  • lībum nātālīcium

    classical · Traupman 280

    lībum, a cheese cake, was the Roman birthday offering. Cato’s recipe: lībum hōc modō facitō (Agr. 75).

See also cake, birthday, birthday party, sweets.

SourcesLewis & Short: libum

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 70.
